title: Megurine Luka — Original Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello, everyone. It's time to “Get on Those Hot Topics!”>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you for introducing our program!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Viewers, our guest for today is Megurine Luka, the VIRTUAL SINGER!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's wonderful to be here.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: As we've been telling our viewers on the show these last few days, the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show is set to be held in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And so! Here on “Get on Those Hot Topics!”, we've been bringing on the participating VIRTUAL SINGERS to hear what they all have to say.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. There's a lot I want to talk about, so I've been looking forward to this.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: I see! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Let's get down to it... Or so I'd like to say, but first, I'll give a brief introduction of Luka to our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: She's Megurine Luka, a VIRTUAL SINGER. This beautiful pink hair of hers is quite iconic.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And she's also known for being bilingual and singing many songs in both Japanese and English.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I suppose that isn't as special as it used to be, but I'm happy to be able to bring people songs in multiple languages.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: That humble smile, how wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: You can feel Luka's unique charm from her calm, mature disposition and grace.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And on the topic of Luka, she also became a hot topic in the news surrounding a recently announced exhibition.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ah, you mean the New Breeze & Reboot Festival.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Can we start by talking about the exhibition?

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: This exhibition is set to be held at a satellite venue tied in with the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Not just music, but illustrations, photos, woodblock prints, sculptures, you name it. All manner of VIRTUAL SINGER art from creators of all disciplines, brought together under one roof!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <A “new breeze”... Just like the exhibition's name evokes, you'll be able to see many works from up-and-coming creators.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We may find that the creators who'll define the next generation will get their start there!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. But a new breeze may not be all that you feel.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <As the “reboot” in the name suggests, we also want this exhibition to be a place where established creators can once again leave their mark.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: The artist who's getting the most attention right now is the sculptor Masaki Sono.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: He'd taken time off from creating to focus on his health in recent years, but with the announcement that he'll be returning to action with his work based on Luka, he's now the subject of much discussion.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: I've had the opportunity to see some of Mr. Sono's works myself, and he makes quite detailed pieces with his delicate touch.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <He does. I never expected I'd be the subject of one of his works, but I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: By the way, it seems that the reason he chose to use you as a theme was because one day, when he was wandering around town, he heard your singing and felt it resound strongly in his heart.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It resounded in his heart...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<If that's the case, I'm very glad.
I'm sure the creator who had me sing that song would be happy to hear it as well.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you for speaking with us today, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<It was my pleasure. I had a wonderful time.
Please allow me to come back and chat again.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Of course, that would be delightful!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We've reached the end of our talk, but please look forward to the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And the New Breeze & Reboot Festival.>

rows.Speaker: Luka & Host
rows.Line:
<We hope you enjoy them.>
We hope you enjoy them.
